description: Compared to the previous version, includes metadata related to citing and cited bibliographic resources added from the [February 2026 version of Crossref](https://api.crossref.org/snapshots/monthly/2026/02/all.json.tar.gz) and the [August 2025 version of JaLC](https://api.japanlinkcenter.org/). It also includes an alignment with [OpenAlex identifiers](https://openalex.s3.amazonaws.com/browse.html) and introduces [OUTCITE](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18172742) and [Matilda](https://matilda.science) as new sources.
stats_note: 3,673,399 editors and 115,504,540 publishers (counted by roles, without disambiguating individuals)
